[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Eupham was born before 1651. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-1149|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Laurimer-1|Eupham Laurimer]].

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1149]] is assessed at 47% (possible). Eupham’s Edinburgh child event dated 8 May 1651 names Robert Glasgow and Eupham Lorimer/Laurimer. The Edinburgh Robert/Eupham Lorimer household is directly recorded, but linking its adult father to the 1627 Inveresk child remains unproved. The same named Lorimer couple is already recorded with an adult cordiner in 1644, when the child would be about sixteen.

Possible identification with Robert-1149 specifically. The recorded Lorimer father is secure; the 1644 chronology makes the childhood mapping less comfortable. Robert-3938 is the distinct 1652 Thomsone bridegroom, not an automatic replacement.

Next useful test: Compare Lorimer-family property or trade records with the 1627 child’s family, keeping the Thomsone account separate.

Source basis already held: [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X1YF-TPJ "Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950", , FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X1YF-TPJ : 16 September 2021), Eupham Glasgow, 1651.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


A possible identification concerns Eupham Glasgow and Alexander Hutcheson. The parish index records Eupham Glasgow with Alexander Hutcheson at Edinburgh on 8 December 1671.<ref>Scotland’s People, Old Parish Registers, banns and marriages, OPR 685 / 1/440 / 129, 1671-12-08, Edinburgh; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The index combines banns and marriage entries; the original register is required to establish the event type. The identification remains uncertain.

A possible identification concerns Effie Glasgow and Alexander Hutcshesone. The parish index records Effie Glasgow with Alexander Hutcshesone at Channelkirk on 17 September 1671.<ref>Scotland’s People, Old Parish Registers, banns and marriages, OPR 729/10 / 230, 1671-09-17, Channelkirk; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The index combines banns and marriage entries; the original register is required to establish the event type. The identification remains uncertain.
